episodes.title: The Hanged Man
episodes.summary: A chronicle of the life of Leonardo da Vinci begins with the Italian artist-inventor in his mid-20s, when he is commissioned by the Medicis to create an Easter spectacle in Florence. Later, he's hired to build war machines, and meets a mysterious Turk.

episodes.title: The Serpent
episodes.summary: Leonardo's quest for the Book of Leaves continues; the pope's nephew meets a spy upon his arrival; and Leonardo's war designs do not measure up for the Medicis, causing a rift between the inventor and the rulers.

episodes.title: The Prisoner
episodes.summary: Riario engages the Pope and a mysterious prisoner in a discussion concerning the count's defeat, while Leonardo searches for a rational explanation when an outbreak of demonic possession occurs at a convent, and the blame is placed on the Medicis.

episodes.title: The Magician
episodes.summary: Bechhi is accused of spying for Rome and arrested; Leonardo unveils his latest weapon when the armies of Rome and Florence square off. Later, at a party in his honor, Leonardo is arrested and charged with sodomy.

episodes.title: The Tower
episodes.summary: Lorenzo demands that Leonardo's estranged father defend his son in court. Later, Leonardo surprises a corrupt judge during a performance for visiting royals, and is surprised himself when the Turk makes an appearance at the workshop.

episodes.title: The Devil
episodes.summary: The Turk's clue about the Book of Leaves leads Leonardo to Wallachia and an encounter with Vlad Dracula, while Lorenzo and Piero have a meeting with the Duke of Urbino. Later, the spy search intensifies.

episodes.title: The Hierophant
episodes.summary: Leonardo constructs a suit for underwater transportation and takes to the sewers to enter the Vatican, where he meets the pope and a mysterious prisoner. Meanwhile, Giuliano reveals the identity of spy in Rome.

episodes.title: The Lovers
episodes.summary: In the series 1 finale, the Pazzis set in motion a plan to murder Lorenzo and Giuliano on Easter Sunday, while the Turk tells Leonardo the location of the Book of Leaves. Later, Lucrezia serves up a startling revelation as Leonardo steps in to save the Medicis.

episodes.title: The Blood of Man
episodes.summary: In the Season 2 premiere, the Pazzis strike, leaving the fate of Florence in Leonardo's hands, while Riario forges on in his quest to attain the Book of Leaves.

episodes.title: The Blood of Brothers
episodes.summary: Leonardo uses his wiles to restore order to Florence, while Pope Sixtus recruits powerful allies and Nico tries not to succumb to Riario's temptations.

episodes.title: The Voyage of the Damned
episodes.summary: Leonardo's quest for the Book of Leaves continues; Pope Sixtus deals aggressively with Florence, leaving Lorenzo to make sacrifices; and Lucrezia undertakes an alliance-forming mission to Rome.

episodes.title: The Ends of the Earth
episodes.summary: Leonardo attempts to navigate the Atlantic without maps; Lucrezia is snuck into the Vatican for a vital meeting; and Lorenzo is recognized on his way to Naples.

episodes.title: The Sun and the Moon
episodes.summary: Leonardo, Riario and Nico are reunited in the New World; Lorenzo is helped by an old flame in his attempt to save Florence; and Clarice's hold on the Medici bank is threatened.

episodes.title: The Rope of the Dead
episodes.summary: Leonardo and Riario are challenged upon entering the Vault of Heaven; Lorenzo participates in King Ferrante's bloody games; and Lucrezia encounters the Turk on her way to Constantinople.

episodes.title: The Vault of Heaven
episodes.summary: Leonardo and his allies' quest for the Book of Leaves turns deadly; Carlo comes to Clarice's aid; and in the East, the son of the Sultan is intrigued with Lucrezia.

episodes.title: The Fall From Heaven
episodes.summary: Leonardo and Riario face death, while Zoroaster and Nico plot an escape. Meanwhile, Lorenzo cools his heels waiting for an audience with the King of Naples; and Bayezid comes to Rome on a diplomatic mission.

episodes.title: The Enemies of Man
episodes.summary: Back in Florence, Leonardo finds an iron-fisted Duke Federico ruling his subjects; a sinful Riario seeks redemption; and King Ferrante enters negotiations with Lorenzo.

episodes.title: The Sins of Daedalus
episodes.summary: In the Season 2 finale, Italian cities brace for an Ottoman attack; danger stalks Riario; and Nico holds Vanessa's destiny in his hands.

episodes.title: Semper Infidelis
episodes.summary: In the Season 3 premiere, the Ottoman Empire invades Otranto, forcing Leonardo and his allies to retreat.

episodes.title: Abbadon
episodes.summary: Leonardo plans an escape from Otranto, but those closest to him may still be imperiled.

episodes.title: Modus Operandi
episodes.summary: Leonardo investigates a horrific murder that may result in the Labyrinth being exposed.

episodes.title: The Labrys
episodes.summary: Carlo's attempt to program Leonardo into becoming "one" with the Labyrinth leads him to slip into an alternate reality that could prove life-threatening.

episodes.title: Anima Venator
episodes.summary: A paranoid Leonardo becomes shut off from his friends, while an endangered Lucrezia searches for a way to make amends for past sins.

episodes.title: Liberum Arbitrium
episodes.summary: The Monster of Italy is captured but not all is safe as danger still lurks and poses a threat to the upcoming Crusade Festival.

episodes.title: Alis Volat Proplis
episodes.summary: A former nemesis returns to Florence and stands in opposition to Crusade efforts; Vanessa and Nico ponder their futures; Leo attempts to decipher the Turkish armor.

episodes.title: La Confessione Della Machina
episodes.summary: Nico and Zo turn to an old enemy to gain support for the Crusade; Leo is ambushed by the Labyrinth.

episodes.title: Angelus Iratissimus
episodes.summary: Leo and Sophia struggle to control the mysterious device they've built. Back in Florence, Riario awaits judgment while Lorenzo and Vanessa take their partnership to the next level.

episodes.title: Ira Deorum
episodes.summary: Leo must put his faith in his friends and in himself to have a chance to defeat the Turks.
